name: Talkiatry
one_liner: Talkiatry is a leading online psychiatry platform that connects you with licensed psychiatrists for medication management, accepting most major insurance plans for accessible virtual psychiatric care.
best_for: People who need psychiatric medication management and have insurance
Those who prefer video appointments from home over in-person visits
People having difficulty finding local psychiatrists with availability
Those wanting a psychiatrist who can also provide therapy (if needed)
People seeking ongoing psychiatric care, not just one-time consultations
not_for: People in immediate psychiatric crisis (call 988 or go to ER)
Those seeking only therapy without medication needs
People without insurance who need low-cost options
Those needing controlled substances with strict telehealth restrictions
short_description: Online psychiatry platform with licensed psychiatrists, medication management, and broad insurance acceptance.
long_description: Talkiatry is a telehealth psychiatry practice that provides psychiatric evaluation, diagnosis, and medication management through video appointments. Unlike some platforms, Talkiatry psychiatrists are employees (not contractors), which allows for better continuity of care. Most appointments are 45-60 minutes for initial evaluations and 20-30 minutes for follow-ups. Talkiatry accepts most major insurance plans and is available in most U.S. states.
patient_summary: Talkiatry connects you with a psychiatrist for video appointments. They can evaluate you, diagnose conditions, and prescribe medications. Most insurance is accepted, so your cost may just be a copay.

pricing.notes: Accepts most major insurance. Without insurance, initial evaluation is approximately $300-400, follow-ups $150-250.

privacy.notes: HIPAA-compliant medical practice. Your data is protected health information.

faqs.a: Talkiatry accepts most major insurance plans including Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and many others. Check their website with your specific plan to confirm coverage.

Yes, Talkiatry psychiatrists can evaluate and treat ADHD, including prescribing stimulant medications in states where telehealth prescribing is permitted. Some states have restrictions on controlled substance prescribing via telehealth.

faqs.q: Is Talkiatry the same as BetterHelp or Talkspace?
faqs.a: No. Talkiatry is psychiatry (medical doctors who can prescribe medication), while BetterHelp and Talkspace primarily offer therapy with licensed therapists. If you need medication, Talkiatry is appropriate. If you need talk therapy without medication, consider therapy platforms.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get an appointment with Talkiatry?
faqs.a: Most patients can get an initial appointment within 1-2 weeks, which is faster than many in-person psychiatrists. Availability varies by location and time of year.
